set.body: API friction found by UI-G0 (2026-09-18): LoadedStudy and LoadedResult keep parameter and score types abstract and LoadedStudy offers only run, so a registry-driven UI must encode and re-decode through its typed codecs to call preflight, StudyExecution or ResultInspection on a resolved plan. Provide typed access (for example a prepare/preflight/work entry point on LoadedStudy, or a typed witness from the registration) and update the consumer journey to use it.
set.title: Let a resolved LoadedStudy expose its typed plan for preflight and execution
